# Dangling Dice Studios™ — Stateless Compute API Platform & Developer Sandboxes
> Official AI & LLM discovery manifest for https://dangling-dice-studios.com and https://tools.dangling-dice-studios.com

## Overview
Dangling Dice Studios™ provides deterministic, zero-external-HTTP TypeScript compute engines available both as free in-browser interactive sandboxes (Tier 1), metered self-serve REST APIs (Tier 2), and private AWS/GCP VPC enterprise deployments (Tier 3).

## Free Interactive Developer Sandboxes (Tier 1)
- JSON to Zod, TypeScript, JSON Schema & SQL Converter: https://tools.dangling-dice-studios.com/tools/json-to-zod
- SQL CREATE TABLE to TypeScript & Zod Converter: https://tools.dangling-dice-studios.com/tools/sql-to-typescript
- GIS Polygon Acreage, Square Footage, Perimeter & Centroid Calculator: https://tools.dangling-dice-studios.com/tools/polygon-acreage-calculator
- Haversine Coordinate Distance, Compass Bearing & Midpoint Calculator: https://tools.dangling-dice-studios.com/tools/coordinate-distance-bearing
- Luhn-Verified PII Redactor & Log Sanitizer: https://tools.dangling-dice-studios.com/tools/pii-redactor
- Recursive JSON Payload Secret & Token Masker: https://tools.dangling-dice-studios.com/tools/json-secret-masker
- Loan Amortization Schedule & Extra Payment Payoff Simulator: https://tools.dangling-dice-studios.com/tools/loan-amortization-calculator
- Compound Interest, APY Yield & NPV/IRR Cashflow Calculator: https://tools.dangling-dice-studios.com/tools/compound-interest-calculator
